xtce:MetaCommand.xtce:LongDescription: Generate a data product from a file, split into chunks. Each chunk is emitted as a FileChunkHeaderRecord (file name, offset, data size) followed by a FileChunkDataRecord containing the chunk bytes, so ground tools can reassemble the original file regardless of DP buffer sizing.

xtce:Argument.name: fileName
xtce:Argument.xtce:LongDescription: The file to package as a data product

xtce:Argument.name: chunkSize
xtce:Argument.xtce:LongDescription: The maximum number of file bytes per chunk

xtce:Argument.xtce:LongDescription: The offset in the file at which to start

xtce:Argument.name: endOffset
xtce:Argument.xtce:LongDescription: The offset in the file at which to stop, exclusive; 0 means the end of the file

xtce:Argument.name: priority
xtce:Argument.xtce:LongDescription: The container priority; 0 means the configured default

xtce:Argument.name: mode
xtce:Argument.xtce:LongDescription: Whether to pace the chunks with the rate group or emit them immediately
